style: Realistic documentary footage, smooth stable cinematic camera motion. Keep the same scene, people and composition. People stay almost still, no hand gestures, no object handling. No text, no letters appear.

clips.prompt: Slow steady dolly forward along the sidewalk past the plastic-wrapped refrigerators, the loose plastic film flutters slightly in the breeze, the man in the distance stays seated and still
Very slow push-in toward the two men and the shop, the two men stand still, the street lamp light flickers softly, evening light slowly dims
Smooth slow forward walking camera through the alley, soft morning sunlight, leaves and hanging plants sway gently, people far away walk slowly away from the camera
